body:
#!/bin/sh
# rgj-sync 0.2 — Retro Gaming Journey, on-device queue keeper.
#
# One POSIX shell script for the whole Linux fleet:
#   ArkOS    : PowKiddy RGB30, PowKiddy RGB10X, Batlexp G350
#   Spruce   : Miyoo A30
#   Onion    : Miyoo Mini Plus
#
# No Python, no jq, no network. Uses only busybox/coreutils tools that ship with
# all three firmwares (sh, awk, sort, mv, mkdir, date, wc).
#
# The contract with the web dashboard (see docs/Device Sync Matrix.md):
#   <root>/rgj-device.json     device identity marker (written by `init` or the page)
#   <root>/rgj/rgj-queue.jsonl rows waiting to be pulled   (NDJSON, one hit per line)
#   <root>/rgj/rgj-ack.json    ack written by the dashboard after a pull
#   <root>/rgj/rgj-ack.keys    same ack as flat keys, written for this script
#   <root>/rgj/rgj-pruned.jsonl rows this script has handed back (never deleted)
#
# Usage:
#   rgj-sync status                what is queued, what has been acked
#   rgj-sync add [FILE]            append capture spool rows to the queue (deduped)
#   rgj-sync prune                 move acked rows out of the queue into rgj-pruned.jsonl
#   rgj-sync tick                  add + prune, for a boot hook or menu launcher
#   rgj-sync init --id ID --model MODEL [--os OS]
#   rgj-sync doctor                check paths and tools
#
# Environment:
#   RGJ_ROOT   card volume root (auto-detected from /roms, /storage/roms, ...)

set -u
VERSION="0.2"

say()  { printf '%s\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf 'rgj-sync: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die()  { warn "$*"; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- root lookup
find_root() {
  if [ -n "${RGJ_ROOT:-}" ]; then
    [ -d "$RGJ_ROOT" ] || die "RGJ_ROOT=$RGJ_ROOT is not a directory"
    printf '%s\n' "$RGJ_ROOT"; return 0
  fi
  for c in /roms /storage/roms /media/roms /mnt/roms "$HOME/roms" \
           /media/sdcard /mnt/sdcard /storage; do
    [ -d "$c" ] || continue
    if [ -f "$c/rgj-device.json" ] || [ -d "$c/rgj" ]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$c"; return 0
    fi
  done
  # fall back to the current directory — this is an SD card root when the user
  # has cd'd into it from a PC, which is how `init` is normally first run
  printf '%s\n' "$PWD"
  return 0
}

ROOT=$(find_root) || die "no card root found — set RGJ_ROOT to the volume holding rgj-device.json"
RGJ="$ROOT/rgj"
QUEUE="$RGJ/rgj-queue.jsonl"
ACK="$RGJ/rgj-ack.json"
KEYS="$RGJ/rgj-ack.keys"
PRUNED="$RGJ/rgj-pruned.jsonl"
SPOOL="$RGJ/capture.spool.jsonl"
MARKER="$ROOT/rgj-device.json"

ensure_dirs() { mkdir -p "$RGJ" || die "cannot create $RGJ"; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- locking
LOCK="$RGJ/.rgj-sync.lock"
locked=0
take_lock() {
  ensure_dirs
  i=0
  while [ $i -lt 40 ]; do
    if mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; then
      locked=1; trap 'release_lock' EXIT INT TERM HUP
      printf '%s\n' $$ > "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || :
      return 0
    fi
    # stale lock: no live pid inside
    if [ -f "$LOCK/pid" ] && ! kill -0 "$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; then
      rm -rf "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || :
      continue
    fi
    sleep 0.25
    i=$((i + 1))
  done
  return 1
}
release_lock() { [ "$locked" = 1 ] && rm -rf "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; locked=0; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- awk helpers
# field(): pull a string or number field out of one JSON object on one line.
AWKLIB='
function field(line, name,   pat, s) {
  pat = "\"" name "\":[ \t]*\"[^\"]*\""
  if (match(line, pat)) { s = substr(line, RSTART, RLENGTH); sub(/^"[^"]*":[ \t]*"/, "", s); sub(/"$/, "", s); return s }
  pat = "\"" name "\":[ \t]*[0-9.]+"
  if (match(line, pat)) { s = substr(line, RSTART, RLENGTH); sub(/^"[^"]*":[ \t]*/, "", s); return s }
  pat = "\"" name "\":[ \t]*(true|false|yes|no)"
  if (match(line, pat)) { s = substr(line, RSTART, RLENGTH); sub(/^"[^"]*":[ \t]*/, "", s); return s }
  return ""
}
function keyof(line) { return field(line,"game_hash") "|" field(line,"achievement_id") "|" field(line,"timestamp") }
'

TMPD=""
mktmp() {
  [ -n "$TMPD" ] && return 0
  TMPD=$(mktemp -d 2>/dev/null) || TMPD="$RGJ/.tmp.$$"
  mkdir -p "$TMPD" || die "cannot create temp dir"
}

# keys present in the ack: one "hash|aid|ts" per line
ack_keys() {
  mktmp
  : > "$TMPD/ack.keys"
  [ -f "$KEYS" ] && sed 's/\r$//' "$KEYS" | awk 'NF' >> "$TMPD/ack.keys"
  if [ -f "$ACK" ]; then
    # fall back to the JSON ack when the flat key file is absent
    awk "$AWKLIB"'
      /\"game_hash\"/ {
        gh = field($0,"game_hash"); aid = field($0,"achievement_id"); ts = field($0,"timestamp")
        if (gh != "" && ts != "") print gh "|" aid "|" ts
      }' "$ACK" >> "$TMPD/ack.keys"
  fi
  sort -u "$TMPD/ack.keys" > "$TMPD/ack.sorted"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands
do_status() {
  count() { awk 'NF { n++ } END { print n + 0 }' "$1" 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }
  q=0; [ -f "$QUEUE" ] && q=$(count "$QUEUE")
  p=0; [ -f "$PRUNED" ] && p=$(count "$PRUNED")
  spool_all=0; [ -f "$SPOOL" ] && spool_all=$(count "$SPOOL")
  ack_keys; a=$(count "$TMPD/ack.sorted")
  # spool rows that are genuinely unknown = not yet queued, not yet acked
  s=$spool_all
  if [ "$spool_all" -gt 0 ]; then
    { awk "$AWKLIB"'
        NF { k = keyof($0); if (k ~ /\|[0-9]/) print k }' "$QUEUE" 2>/dev/null
      cat "$TMPD/ack.sorted" 2>/dev/null
    } | sort -u > "$TMPD/known2"
    s=$(awk -v kf="$TMPD/known2" "$AWKLIB"'
      BEGIN { while ((getline l < kf) > 0) seen[l] = 1 }
      NF { k = keyof($0); if (!(k in seen)) n++ }
      END { print n + 0 }' "$SPOOL")
  fi

  say "root      : $ROOT"
  if [ -f "$MARKER" ]; then
    m=$(tr -d '\n\r' < "$MARKER" | head -c 600)
    id=$(printf '%s' "$m" | awk "$AWKLIB"' { print field($0,"device_id") }')
    mo=$(printf '%s' "$m" | awk "$AWKLIB"' { print field($0,"model") }')
    os=$(printf '%s' "$m" | awk "$AWKLIB"' { print field($0,"os") }')
    say "device    : ${mo:-unnamed} · ${id:-no id}"
    say "os        : ${os:-unknown}"
  else
    say "device    : no rgj-device.json (run: rgj-sync init --id ... --model ...)"
  fi
  say "queue     : $q row(s)  $QUEUE"
  say "acked     : $a key(s) known to the dashboard"
  say "spool     : $s row(s) not yet queued  $SPOOL"
  say "pruned    : $p row(s) handed back  $PRUNED"

  if [ -f "$QUEUE" ] && [ "$q" -gt 0 ]; then
    awk "$AWKLIB"'
      { ts = field($0,"timestamp") + 0;
        games[field($0,"game_hash")] = 1;
        if (min == "" || ts < min) min = ts
        if (ts > max) max = ts
        n++ }
      END {
        g = 0; for (x in games) g++;
        printf "oldest    : %s\n", (min == "" ? "-" : strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", min))
        printf "newest    : %s\n", (max == "" ? "-" : strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", max))
        printf "games     : %d distinct\n", g
      }' "$QUEUE" 2>/dev/null || :
  fi
  [ "$s" -gt 0 ] && say "next      : rgj-sync add"
  [ "$q" -gt 0 ] && say "next      : plug into the PC and press \"Pull from card\" on the Sync tab"
  return 0
}

do_add() {
  src="${1:-$SPOOL}"
  [ -f "$src" ] || { say "nothing to add — $src does not exist"; return 0; }
  take_lock || die "another rgj-sync is running (remove $LOCK if stale)"
  ensure_dirs
  [ -f "$QUEUE" ] || : > "$QUEUE"
  mktmp
  ack_keys
  before=$(awk 'NF { n++ } END { print n + 0 }' "$QUEUE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  # known = everything already queued plus everything already acked
  { awk "$AWKLIB"'
      NF { k = keyof($0); if (k ~ /\|[0-9]/) print k }' "$QUEUE" 2>/dev/null
    cat "$TMPD/ack.sorted" 2>/dev/null
  } | sort -u > "$TMPD/known"

  awk -v known="$TMPD/known" "$AWKLIB"'
    BEGIN { while ((getline l < known) > 0) seen[l] = 1 }
    {
      sub(/\r$/, "")
      if ($0 !~ /game_hash/) next
      gh = field($0,"game_hash"); aid = field($0,"achievement_id"); ts = field($0,"timestamp")
      if (gh == "" || aid == "" || ts == "") { skipped++; next }
      k = gh "|" aid "|" ts
      if (k in seen) { dupes++; next }
      seen[k] = 1
      if ($0 !~ /hardcore/) {
        sub(/\}[ \t]*$/, ",\"hardcore\":false}", $0)
      }
      print
      taken++
    }
    END { printf "%d %d %d\n", taken + 0, dupes + 0, skipped + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }
  ' "$src" > "$TMPD/new.rows" 2> "$TMPD/counts"

  read taken dupes skipped < "$TMPD/counts" 2>/dev/null || { taken=0; dupes=0; skipped=0; }
  if [ "${taken:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
    cat "$TMPD/new.rows" >> "$QUEUE"
  fi
  after=$(awk 'NF { n++ } END { print n + 0 }' "$QUEUE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  release_lock
  say "added $taken row(s) to the queue ($dupes already seen, $skipped malformed)"
  say "queue: $before -> $after row(s)"
  [ "${taken:-0}" -eq 0 ] && say "spool left untouched: $src"
  return 0
}

do_prune() {
  take_lock || die "another rgj-sync is running (remove $LOCK if stale)"
  [ -f "$QUEUE" ] || { release_lock; say "queue is empty — nothing to prune"; return 0; }
  ack_keys
  mktmp
  # awk only creates a redirect target when it writes to it, so a run where every row is
  # acked would leave queue.new absent and the mv below would fail. Create both up front.
  : > "$TMPD/pruned"
  : > "$TMPD/queue.new"
  awk -v ackf="$TMPD/ack.sorted" -v pruned="$TMPD/pruned" -v kept="$TMPD/queue.new" "$AWKLIB"'
    BEGIN { while ((getline l < ackf) > 0) acked[l] = 1 }
    {
      sub(/\r$/, "")
      if ($0 !~ /game_hash/) { print $0 > kept; nk++; next }
      k = keyof($0)
      if (k in acked) { print $0 > pruned; npr++; next }
      print $0 > kept; nk++
    }
    END { printf "%d %d\n", npr + 0, nk + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$QUEUE" 2> "$TMPD/counts"

  read npr nkeep < "$TMPD/counts" 2>/dev/null || { npr=0; nkeep=0; }
  if [ "${npr:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
    # Move first, then record: if the rewrite fails the queue must stay exactly as it was,
    # and a half-written audit trail would be worse than none.
    [ -f "$TMPD/queue.new" ] || : > "$TMPD/queue.new"
    if mv "$TMPD/queue.new" "$QUEUE"; then
      cat "$TMPD/pruned" >> "$PRUNED"
    else
      die "could not rewrite $QUEUE — queue left unchanged"
    fi
  fi
  release_lock
  say "pruned $npr acked row(s); $nkeep still queued"
  [ "$npr" -gt 0 ] && say "rows appended to $PRUNED (never deleted)"
  return 0
}

do_tick() { do_add "${1:-$SPOOL}"; do_prune; }

do_init() {
  id=""; model=""; os="ArkOS"; schema=1; queue="rgj/rgj-queue.jsonl"; ack="rgj/rgj-ack.json"
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --id) id="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --model) model="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --os) os="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      *) die "unknown init option: $1" ;;
    esac
  done
  [ -n "$id" ] || die "init needs --id (e.g. --id rgb30_hw01)"
  [ -n "$model" ] || model="$id"
  ensure_dirs
  if [ -f "$MARKER" ]; then
    say "$MARKER already exists — left untouched"
  else
    cat > "$MARKER" <<JSON
{
  "device_id": "$id",
  "model": "$model",
  "os": "$os",
  "schema": $schema,
  "queue": "$queue",
  "ack": "$ack"
  return 0
}
JSON
    say "wrote $MARKER ($id)"
  fi
  [ -f "$QUEUE" ] || : > "$QUEUE"
  say "queue file ready: $QUEUE"
}

do_doctor() {
  say "rgj-sync $VERSION"
  say "root      : $ROOT"
  say "writable  : $( ( : > "$RGJ/.wtest" ) 2>/dev/null && printf yes || printf 'NO — check the mount is not read-only' )"
  rm -f "$RGJ/.wtest" 2>/dev/null || :
  for t in awk sort sed grep mktemp date tr wc; do
    if command -v $t >/dev/null 2>&1; then say "tool $t : ok"; else say "tool $t : MISSING"; fi
  done
  [ -f "$MARKER" ] && say "marker    : ok" || say "marker    : missing (run init)"
  say "ack keys  : $(awk 'NF { n++ } END { print n + 0 }' "$KEYS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  return 0
}

case "${1:-status}" in
  status)  do_status ;;
  add)     shift; do_add "$@" ;;
  prune)   do_prune ;;
  tick)    shift; do_tick "$@" ;;
  init)    shift; do_init "$@" ;;
  doctor)  do_doctor ;;
  -h|--help|help) sed -n '2,40p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' ;;
  *) die "unknown command: $1 (try: status, add, prune, tick, init, doctor)" ;;
esac
